name: Onyx Meridian
tagline: The operating system for the practice you were meant to build.
positioning: Onyx Meridian unifies scheduling, recall, claims, and chairside ops into one command center built for independent dental practices.

hero.h1: Run your practice like an empire, not an emergency.
hero.sub: Onyx Meridian pulls scheduling, recall, insurance verification, and daily production into a single command center — so owner-dentists stop firefighting and start compounding.

features.title: Recall that never sleeps
features.description: Automated hygiene recall chases every overdue patient across text, email, and voicemail until the chair is filled — no front-desk reminders required.

features.title: Instant eligibility checks
features.description: Verify insurance benefits and remaining maximums in seconds, before the patient sits down, so no claim gets written off as a surprise.

features.title: Production at a glance
features.description: See daily production, collections, and open chair time across every operatory on one live dashboard built for the owner, not the software vendor.

features.title: Fill the schedule automatically
features.description: Smart waitlists backfill last-minute cancellations by texting the right patient the moment a slot opens, protecting your hourly production goal.

features.title: Claims that actually get paid
features.description: Auto-attach x-rays and perio charts, scrub for coding errors, and track every claim from submission to deposit without leaving the platform.

features.title: One login for every chair
features.description: Front desk, hygienists, associates, and you share the same source of truth — with per-seat permissions tuned to each role.

testimonials.quote: We recovered $41K in unbilled hygiene in the first quarter. Onyx Meridian didn't just tidy our schedule — it changed how I think about running the practice.
testimonials.name: Dr. Priya Nadkarni

testimonials.quote: My front desk stopped playing phone tag with insurers. Eligibility is verified before I ever pick up an explorer. It feels like adding a full-time coordinator.
testimonials.name: Dr. Marcus Bellini

testimonials.quote: I finally have one dashboard that tells me production, collections, and open time without exporting three reports. It's the closest thing to a co-pilot I've had in 18 years.
testimonials.name: Dr. Elena Ruiz
